Download Clients

NGMS ships with embedded torrent and usenet engines. External clients are also supported.

Embedded engines (recommended for new installs)

Both embedded engines are enabled from Settings → Download Clients → Embedded. No external process is needed — they run inside the NGMS binary.

EngineProtocolNotes
Embedded Torrent (librtbit) BitTorrent Full BitTorrent client — DHT, PEX, piece selection, seeding, ratio rules
Embedded Usenet (nzb-web) NNTP / NZB Downloads, yEnc decode, PAR2 repair, unrar — full pipeline in-process
✦
The embedded usenet engine requires NNTP server credentials — add them in Settings → Usenet Providers. The embedded torrent engine needs no additional credentials.

External clients

Go to Settings → Download Clients → Add and choose a client type:

ClientProtocolHow NGMS connects
SABnzbdUsenetSABnzbd API — URL + API key
NZBGetUsenetXMLRPC — host, port, username, password
qBittorrentTorrentqBittorrent Web API — URL + credentials
DelugeTorrentDeluge JSON-RPC — URL + password
TransmissionTorrentTransmission RPC — URL + credentials

Client priority and routing

When multiple clients are configured, NGMS routes grabs by protocol first (usenet releases go to usenet clients, torrents to torrent clients), then by the priority order you set. Drag to reorder clients in the settings list.

You can also assign a category per client — NGMS will tag each grab with that category so the external client can apply its own routing rules (e.g. different save paths per category).

Verifying a client works

After saving a client, click Test. NGMS will attempt a connection and report any errors. Then do a manual search (series or movie → Search → grab a release) and verify it appears in the client's queue.
